name: Vesta homelab remediation (sandboxed)
description: How Vesta inspects and repairs the homelab cluster and publishes GitOps fixes from akhsbxd/akhexecd sandboxes: the credential-free vesta-gitops workspace (shell_exec and the file tools) and the vesta-ops sandbox (sandbox_exec, ServiceAccount vesta, vesta/*-only deploy key). Replaces the tool descriptions and policy prose of deploy/roman-mini/vesta_ops.py, vesta_actions.py and configure_vesta.py (53g PR 8, plan decision D5).
